nodes.description: Public function post(string calldata content) that emits the NewPost event with msg.sender and content; no state mutation and no access restriction.
msg.sender, the caller-supplied address used as the indexed user argument of the emitted NewPost event.
Function parameter content (string calldata) supplied by the caller and forwarded verbatim into the emitted event.
emit NewPost(msg.sender, content) statement, the only operation performed by the contract, writing untrusted caller data into an event log.

edges.reason: Execution of post always reaches the emit NewPost statement, which is the sole operation in the function body.
msg.sender is read as the indexed user argument of the NewPost event; it is an untrusted address but is only logged, not used for authorization or state change.
The caller-supplied content parameter flows directly into the NewPost event payload without validation or transformation.
msg.sender is referenced inside post to build the event arguments, tying the untrusted caller identity to the function.
The content parameter is consumed by post as its only input argument.

normalization_plan.reason: The content parameter is a non-core node whose only role is to feed the post function and its emit statement, so it is normalized into the post function node.
